title: Web 通知中心 / 通知页
prerequisites: Applicant logged into the web header
steps: Broadcast a live system notification as admin to verified users.
Opened the header notification center and captured unread badge + popover state.
Marked all as read in the popover, then opened the full `/en/notifications` page.
userVisibleResult: The notification center and full notifications page both rendered and reacted to a live broadcast notification.
